push.title: L 1-4 vs Real Zurich FC | You: 8.7 (4th best match performance)
push.body:
Hoo-wee, tuxedo_slide. An 8.7. You played like someone who ate their vegetables.

THE GOOD
+ 8 tackles attempted (up from your usual 4). You chased like a golden retriever after a tennis ball, and I mean that as a compliment.
+ That's your 4th best match performance with an 8.7. Proud doesn't cover it.
+ Passes attempted 18, from 8 in your previous match. That's what showing up looks like.

THE BAD
- BellyTb1 had the same passing accuracy trouble. Team up on it: give each other short options.
- Goal involvements 0, down from your usual 1. That's not you at your best, and we both know it.
- In our wins you average 1 key passes; here it was 0. Between you and me: Receive on the half-turn so your first touch can go forward.
- Most missed tackles on the team: 5 (best was buddskees's 0). A little secret: Press to cut the passing lane, not to lunge at the ball carrier from behind.
- 4 goals conceded docked 0.1. Small leak, easy patch.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 44% (8 of 18). That's the part of tonight I'd burn if it were on paper. Homework: Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.

Teach your feet: Simple and on the ground to the open, facing teammate. Driven and lofted balls are for clear lanes only.

tuxedo_slide, one more thing before you log off: Your feet are only as fast as your eyes. Look first.

I'll be smiling about that one all week. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 1-4 vs Real Zurich FC | You: 7.1 (3rd worst match performance)
push.body:
buddskees, a 7.1 against Real Zurich FC is your 3rd worst match performance. We'll climb back up the list.

THE GOOD
+ 3 key passes, the most you've made for us. That's a pass with a bow on it.
+ Better pass accuracy than any of their humans (80% vs their best 68%). I'd put that on a billboard if I could afford one.
+ Team-high 1 goal involvements. That's a habit, and habits win leagues.

THE BAD
- Only 15 passes (up from your usual 10). Pro tip: Drift into the half-space between their midfield and defense. It's the hardest spot to mark. Promise it's worth it.
- No tackles attempted. Training homework: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.
- Their best midfielder posted 9.5 to your 7.1. That's the bit that kept us from winning.
- You and BellyTb1 have a shared to-do on defensive work rate: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- Shots on target 0, down from your usual 1. For next time: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

Practice prescription: Play with your head up between touches. You can't find a pass you never looked for.

Before you go, buddskees: Believe it, then go do it.

Good effort, better days ahead. - Coach Lasso
